renderings.value: Pfft! That's what you get for laughing at a girl!
Pfft! That's your punishment for laughing at a girl!
Her very frowns are fairer far than smiles of other maidens are.
He makes young girls' hearts flutter.
"Despite appearances, you're a pervert." "I'm not a pervert. I'm a pure and innocent young girl." "Yeah, yeah, give me a break."
Tom couldn't hide his nervousness at being surrounded by a group of excessively lovely maidens.
